title: run_record.json
description: Provenance of one result tree (F35): results/{hash}/run_record.json, also served as GET /results/{hash}/provenance. Written by WS11 for every live result and for the pinned precomputed ones (official and picker pads); read by the WS13 verify view (#/plan/{hash}/provenance).
x-source: Backend spec F23, F25, F35; D57; D97 (route_mode, feasibility, v1.2.0)

inputs.description: the inputs with every default filled in (what was hashed, plus the title if any)

config_hash.description: tools/make_bundle.py config_hash over config/*.yaml except backend.yaml (D57)

terrain_hash.description: sha256 of the server data manifest (tools/make_serverdata.py)

files.description: every file of the result tree except run_record.json, paths relative to results/{hash}/

contract.description: schema file it validated against (contracts/), null for PNG and other non-JSON files

range_flags.description: inputs outside the anchored range (F26): config/backend.yaml ranges.anchored_flag_note

key.description: dotted path in plan_inputs, e.g. crew.suit_kg

route_mode.description: v1.2.0 (D97): inputs.route.mode; auto when the route is absent

feasibility.description: v1.2.0 (D97): the answer for the route as given. feasible true: every leg keeps its margins. feasible false: the first failing leg, its limit and the shortfall; the files of the legs planned before it are in the tree. Infeasible is a result (job status done), not an error. Absent in records written before v1.2.0.

leg.description: first failing leg: 0 = pad to stops[0], i = stops[i-1] to stops[i], len(stops) = last stop to pad

from.description: 'pad', a station id or a free point W1, W2, ...

to.description: 'pad', a station id or a free point W1, W2, ...

limit.description: the limit that fails first: O2 at the effort-cap rule (D45), daylight, dose, EVA duration (D28)

shortfall_min.description: minutes short on that limit (the negative margin as a positive number)

legs_planned.description: legs before the failing one whose files are in the tree

infeasible.description: F25: infeasible plans are answered, not refused. null (or absent) when every leg keeps margin >= 0. v1.2.0: superseded by feasibility (D97); kept for v1.1 readers.

leg.description: index of the first leg (0 = pad to first station) where the margin goes negative
